title: aethusa cynapium f. agrestis
intro: Aethusa cynapium f. agrestis, commonly known as Wild Carrot or Fool's Parsley, is a plant species belonging to the carrot family (Apiaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including treating digestive issues, such as indigestion and nausea, and as a natural remedy for fever reduction and antispasmodic properties. The therapeutic actions of Aethusa cynapium f. agrestis include its anticholinergic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects, which contribute to its traditional use in treating various ailments. Bioactive constituents found in this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
